turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
return?
menu
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard elective returns.
For a damaged item, you must report it within 10 days of delivery. We replace defective or damaged items and require photo or video evidence of the damage in order to process a replacement or refund.
Standard elective returns, by contrast, fall under our 60-day trial period where items must be returned in original packaging. If you'd like to get your damaged item claim started, just share your order number!

No, you will not have to pay for return shipping on a valid claim for a damaged or defective item.
When an item is reported as damaged within the 10-day window and verified with photo proof, we cover the replacement or return process. If you purchased the optional Free Returns & Package Protection at checkout, return labels and damage claims are also fully covered.
